Dear partner,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our proposal for your consideration. We offer a price of €16.00 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, and delivery EXW.

As a growing supplier, we are very eager to build a strong partnership with your company and to prove ourselves as a reliable, long-term partner for your manufacturing needs. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We remain at your full disposal should you have any questions or require any further information, and we look forward to the prospect of working together.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.text:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our offer is a price of €17.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP. As an alternative, we can propose a price of €17.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP. To offer you €17.30 per unit under these new delivery conditions, we ask to maintain 45-day payment terms.

We appreciate your volume commitment of 6,000 pieces per year; could you please provide the forecasts supporting this volume? Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Which volume can you commit to? 

We can accommodate your request for DAP delivery and a 35-day lead time, though these terms inherently increase the unit price compared to our initial EXW offer. Please note that material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.text:
Hallo,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Here are the terms: a price of €14.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery DAP. 

If we keep the payment at 30 days, I can drop the price to €14.30 per piece. Let's agree on this so we can get the machines running. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH
